thesis: Concordant Crossroads gives every creature haste, turning a symmetrical one-mana enchantment into a combo tool for the player prepared to exploit the first decisive turn.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The card moved from early green oddity to a recurring engine in creature combo, Elves, and Commander, establishing the danger of globally granting haste at minimal cost.

playbook.role: Cast it only when the haste immediately produces mana, attacks, or a lethal combo. Holding Crossroads until the winning turn prevents the opponent from receiving the same benefit first.
